name: korean-lunar-astro
description: Korean lunar calendar (음력) conversion computed astronomically — VSOP87 + Meeus, no lookup tables, no supported-range cliff. Handles leap months (윤달) including the 2033 edge case.
author: UVcat <edit_plus@naver.com>

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node scripts/fixup-cjs.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/api.test.mjs test/golden.test.mjs
